EWE3403.description:
Apartment with sea views for sale in Manilva.

We are pleased to present a new development in the charming area of Los Hidalgos, La Duquesa, Manilva, on the Costa del Sol. It is a great opportunity to live in luxury close to the popular town of Marbella, with everything this area has to offer.

The project comprises 38 stylish apartments and penthouses with large terraces and sea views. The homes have been designed for comfort and style. The open-plan kitchen and living room create a bright, spacious space, and large windows let in plenty of natural light and frame the views.

Choose your favourite: a ground-floor apartment with a private garden, or a penthouse with a sunny terrace and private pool. Whichever you choose, every home has breathtaking sea views.

Each property includes an underground parking space with a pre-installed electric car charger and a separate storage room.

Outside, residents can enjoy beautifully landscaped communal gardens with native plants and a large swimming pool, the perfect place to relax.

Location

Manilva, surrounded by well-known Andalusian resorts, has something other towns on the Costa del Sol cannot offer: vineyards, which cover the surrounding hills. Manilva's limited-production wine is a true symbol of the region.

The town lies 97 km from Málaga and has two parts: the tourist resort by the beach and the town itself, with its white historic houses. Manilva has kept the feel of a traditional Spanish village. Close to the Strait of Gibraltar, it is rich in geography and culture, and a place for a peaceful stay away from the bustle of big cities. The nearest airport is 41 km away.

The beaches are among the best on the Costa del Sol, with almost 8 km of coastline. Some are rocky with small coves, at Punta Chullera, while wide sandy beaches lie next to the Castillo, the port of Puerto de la Duquesa and the town of Sabinillas. You can swim, dive, fish and enjoy water sports.

Besides its beaches and marina, Manilva has an interesting history and culture, including the castle of La Duquesa, several churches and the archaeological finds in the Municipal Archaeological Museum.

A viewing says more than any description!

EWE3832.description:
New-build apartments for sale near the beach in Lo Pagán

Elite World Estates presents a modern development in the coastal area of Lo Pagán, on the Costa Cálida. It is an excellent opportunity for anyone looking for a comfortable apartment in Spain that combines contemporary architecture, high-quality finishes and a prime location, just a few minutes' walk from the Mar Menor beaches and all everyday services.

The complex offers carefully designed apartments with a spacious living and dining room, an open-plan kitchen, one or two bedrooms and one or two elegant bathrooms. Large windows bring in plenty of natural light, while the generous terraces are the perfect place to relax and enjoy the Mediterranean climate all year round. Some homes also have a private solarium for extra outdoor space.

Residents can enjoy an attractive communal area with a rooftop pool and solarium, with views over the surroundings and sun all year round. The building stands out for its contemporary architecture, elegant finishes and high-quality materials that suit the coastal character of the area.

Distances
Lo Pagán beach (Mar Menor): 600 m
Villananitos beach: approx. 700 m
Town centre, shops and restaurants: 1.5 km
Golf courses: approx. 12 km
Murcia International Airport (Corvera): approx. 39 km (35–40 min)
Alicante Airport: approx. 75 km (50 min)

Expected completion

March 2028

Location

The development is in San Pedro del Pinatar, one of the most attractive towns on the Costa Cálida, just 600 metres from the sandy beaches of the Mar Menor. It is an ideal location both for living all year round and for buying a home to let as a holiday rental, thanks to its location, full infrastructure and wide range of leisure.

Nearby you will find restaurants, cafés, supermarkets, shops, schools, medical centres and a marina. The town is known for its beautiful seafront promenade, the famous therapeutic mud of the Mar Menor and many walking and cycling routes. Sports lovers will also enjoy the nearby golf courses, water sports and the Las Salinas y Arenales de San Pedro del Pinatar Regional Park.

Excellent road links take you to Murcia International Airport in about 35 minutes and to Alicante Airport in about 50 minutes, making this property a great choice both as a second home and as an investment with strong rental potential.
